headline: Schoolgirl kidnapped and gang-raped in Faridpur
summary: The victim was allegedly abducted from her home at night by breaking into her house through a window.
details: A schoolgirl has been allegedly kidnapped and gang-raped in Faridpur. The incident occurred when perpetrators broke into the girl's home at night and abducted her.
According to reports, the attackers broke through the window of the house to gain entry and forcibly took the girl away from her residence.
The family of the victim has filed a complaint regarding the abduction and gang-rape, and local authorities are investigating the incident.
This shocking crime has sparked outrage among local residents, highlighting concerns over safety and security in the area.

headline: PM drives himself through Dhaka to inspect city management
summary: The Prime Minister took the wheel to personally monitor cleanliness and civic services across the capital.
details: The Prime Minister personally drove a vehicle through the streets of Dhaka to inspect the city's urban management and cleanliness.
The visit focused on monitoring the effectiveness of civic services and the overall state of city maintenance.
By driving herself, the leader aimed to get a first-hand look at the current conditions of the capital's roads and public facilities.
The inspection included a review of how urban management systems are functioning on the ground to ensure better service delivery for citizens.
